sources.summary: Design studios Cella Collective and Mitre & Mondays have designed a timber-framed installation for this year's Houghton Festival in Norfolk, England, covering its walls with thatch sourced from sustainable reedbeds. Named the Water Tower, the installation provided a restful seating space between the food area and one of the stages at the music and arts event The post Cella Collective and Mitre & Mondays cloak tower with thatched walls at Houghton Festival appeared first on Dezeen .
